All required join columns (t1.building_id_espm, t3.address_1, t2.facility_name, t4.facility_name, t2.building_id_espm, t1.address_1) are included, both leaf nodes contribute at least one non-join numeric metric, and total selected columns are eight (within the 6–9 range). The result yields a meaningful view of how emissions and site energy usage vary across matched buildings and facilities.
